skill.summary: Manage AI agent team members with roles, skills, and task delegation. Use when: listing team members, adding/updating agents, setting the team leader, checki...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Major updates to documentation: SKILL.md and README greatly expanded with clearer usage, parameters, error handling, and use cases.
- New workspace added with detailed benchmark, evaluation metadata, and test outputs to support evaluation of core scenarios (list, add, set leader, find expert).
- Script improvements (team.py): now supports more parameters (e.g., --load-workflow, --group), better error handling, and enforces single-leader rule with clear feedback.
- Enhanced instructions for delegation, team management, and workflow, emphasizing task assignment, role changes, and member enabling/disabling.
- Safer data management: clearer reset behavior and improved resilience to missing or corrupted data files.
